title: Entra Conditional Access policy plans enter public preview: shared conditions, many rules
summary: Microsoft Entra Conditional Access policy plans are in public preview. A plan groups related rules under shared assignments and conditions so common targeting and emergency-access exclusions are defined once, then each rule adds the grant and session controls for its scenario. Existing standalone Conditional Access policies keep working; at sign-in every applicable policy and every applicable plan rule must be satisfied. Migrating selected policies into a plan is supported; migrated rules start Off.
why: Policy sprawl and missed break-glass exclusions are how tenants lock themselves out. Plans attack both problems, but preview behaviour still matters: location-conditioned plan rules currently issue one-hour tokens without instant IP enforcement, and plans accumulate with your existing policies rather than replacing them.
todo: Read the Learn concept and migration articles before touching production policies.

Pilot with a Conditional Access Administrator on a low-risk objective (for example one shared break-glass exclusion set) and leave migrated rules Off or Report-only until sign-in evidence looks right.
Do not delete working standalone policies until the equivalent plan rules are proven; plans are additive during evaluation.
Track the location-condition preview limitation if you rely on named locations for near-real-time IP enforcement.
effective_note: Public preview as of the Learn documentation checked 2026-11-03; no single GA date in the concept article.
